text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock B and C after gains, then held through a prolonged account decline; I should not let loss aversion or reluctance to admit a mistake keep me from reassessing positions.","I made no trades during the later declines, so I should set clear portfolio-level risk and review rules rather than either freeze or react to every price move.","Average cost and past price changes do not predict future returns; I should judge each holding by its current prospects and role in the portfolio, not by whether it is showing a gain or loss."]}
